settings.question: What is ShineWpride?
settings.answer: ShineWpride is an online store offering LGBTQ+ themed apparel, accessories, and art from independent creators. We celebrate pride, identity, and self-expression through high-quality, meaningful designs.

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer: Browse our collections, select your product and size, add it to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll receive an order confirmation email once your purchase is complete.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. All transactions are secured with SSL encryption.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping typically takes 5–10 business days domestically and 10–20 business days internationally. Express options are available at checkout. See our Shipping Policy for full details.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer free standard shipping on orders over $50. The free shipping progress bar in your cart shows how close you are to qualifying.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unworn, unwashed items in original condition. Custom or personalized items may not be eligible. See our Refund & Return Policy for details.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number and link. You can also log into your account to view order status.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement. After that, production may have already started. Contact us at hello@shinewpride.com as soon as possible.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International orders may be subject to customs duties and taxes, which are the responsibility of the recipient.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer: Reach us via our Contact page, email hello@shinewpride.com, or through our social media channels. We typically respond within 1–2 business days.
